steps.name: map modes
steps.expr: const out=[]; for (const m of ['ft','lp','bitfit','adapter','pt','lora']) { document.querySelector('#map-btns [data-m='+m+']').click(); out.push(m+': '+document.querySelector('#map-out .stat .v').textContent+' / '+document.getElementById('map-check').textContent.trim()); } return out.join(' | ')

steps.name: toy
steps.expr: const out=[]; for (const m of ['lp','ft','lpft']) { document.querySelector('#toy-btns [data-m='+m+']').click(); out.push(document.querySelector('#toy-out .toy-row.on').textContent.trim()); } return out.join(' | ')

steps.name: reveal all
steps.expr: const ids=['btn-kumar-reveal','btn-prompt-reveal','btn-latency-reveal','btn-init-reveal','btn-rank-reveal','btn-where-reveal','btn-r-reveal','btn-sort-reveal','btn-speed-reveal','btn-fit-reveal','btn-board-reveal']; const out=[]; for (const id of ids) { const b=document.getElementById(id); if(!b){out.push(id+':MISSING');continue;} b.click(); out.push(id+':'+b.textContent); } return out.join(' ')

steps.name: states
steps.expr: for (const m of ['train','merge','init']) document.querySelector('#lora-btns [data-m='+m+']').click(); document.querySelector('#prompt-init [data-m=random]').click(); document.querySelector('#prompt-init [data-m=text]').click(); const r=document.getElementById('rank-r'); r.value=1; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); r.value=4; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const n=document.getElementById('mem-n'); n.value=3; n.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); n.value=4; n.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return 'ok · score: '+document.getElementById('score').textContent

steps.name: svg text clipping
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach((s,si)=>{ const vb=s.viewBox.baseVal; if(!vb||!vb.width) return; s.querySelectorAll('text').forEach(t=>{ if(t.getAttribute('transform')) return; let b; try{b=t.getBBox();}catch(e){return;} if(b.width===0) return; if(b.x<-1||b.y<-1||b.x+b.width>vb.width+1||b.y+b.height>vb.height+1) bad.push((s.closest('[id]')||{id:'svg'+si}).id+': "'+t.textContent.slice(0,30)+'" '+Math.round(b.x)+','+Math.round(b.y)+' '+Math.round(b.width)+'x'+Math.round(b.height)+' in '+vb.width+'x'+vb.height); }); }); return bad.length? bad.slice(0,25).join(' | ') : 'no clipped text'

steps.name: svg text overlaps
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach((s,si)=>{ const ts=Array.from(s.querySelectorAll('text')).filter(t=>!t.getAttribute('transform')&&t.textContent.trim()); const bs=ts.map(t=>{try{return t.getBBox();}catch(e){return null;}}); for(let i=0;i<ts.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){ const a=bs[i],b=bs[j]; if(!a||!b||!a.width||!b.width) continue; const ox=Math.min(a.x+a.width,b.x+b.width)-Math.max(a.x,b.x), oy=Math.min(a.y+a.height,b.y+b.height)-Math.max(a.y,b.y); if(ox>3&&oy>3) bad.push((s.closest('[id]')||{id:'svg'+si}).id+': "'+ts[i].textContent.slice(0,22)+'" x "'+ts[j].textContent.slice(0,22)+'"'); } }); return bad.length? bad.slice(0,25).join(' | ') : 'no overlaps'
